title: 第11章 倾尽全力第12章 刀法礼物求月票

“第一批保送名单出来了。”方羽道：“我没能入选。”
“嗯。”方平安并不感意外。
他未责怪，反而安慰道：“你还没觉醒虚空星相，生命层次进步不错，但也不算同届最顶尖，也就技艺排名靠前，没入选也正常。”
方平安知道自己儿子修炼已经极刻苦，故而，他并不会说太多空话套话。
“我记得，是8月15号进行二次考核吧。”方平安道：“虽然9月还有一次实战考核的机会……实战考核，是要前往原初星的。”
一提及原初星，方平安眼神顿了顿。
方羽明白为什么。
母亲，当年是一名实力不俗的28级武者，但在在自己刚上初中时，死在了原初星上，连尸体都未能寻回……从那时起，这件事便是父亲心中的一根刺。
“实战考核，危险系数极高。”
“虽说，武者都要经历生死搏杀，但还是等实力更强为好。”方平安低沉道：“所以，你要争取在第二批保送名单里。”
方羽微微点头。
“我的计划，是给你专门请一位武道老师，近身指点，再购买一批修炼药物……”方平安道：“看能不能在一个月内，让你生命层次再提一提，也争取让武道技艺突破至入微大成。”
方羽心中一暖。
父亲，并没有因为弟弟妹妹觉醒，就改变对自己的态度……实际上，若是正常家庭，哪怕自己初中开始就显露不俗的技艺天赋，可高中没觉醒虚空星相时，也该放弃了。
培养孩子，正常来说，是要谈回报比的。
一条希望不大的路，不止浪费金钱，也是在浪费孩子时间。
曾经，方羽也曾动摇。
可父亲顶着压力，前前后后，为自己的的武道之路投入数百万星币。
后来。

高考结束，方羽生命层次达到8级，才觉醒天赋神通‘吞食’，且在逐渐尝试中，感受到这门神通的特殊，方才进一步坚定武道信念，决心要闯出一条路。
如此，才对得起父亲的付出。
不过。
哪怕预想到自己的沉睡星相很特殊，很可能比十二上位星相还要特殊，方羽也没有透露给父亲太多……虚空星相，在未成大地武者前，是无法外显的。
像中考、高考的检测手段。
都是通过学生吸收星力的效率来判定，星相品阶越高，吸收效率越高……而方羽无法吸收星力。
也就没法证实。
另一方面。
方羽也不确定，自己生命层次要多少级才能彻底觉醒星相，若是要30级甚至40级呢？一切都是未知的。
那都是父亲无法负担的。
“父亲给我帮助够大了，家里钱也就这么多。”
“弟弟妹妹还在成长，所需各种资源会更多……”方羽想的很清楚：“想要更多，那就靠自己拼吧。”
这也是大专三年来，方羽修炼愈发刻苦的原因。
学校的各种奖学金他拿到不少，他也在兼职，加上父亲给的钱……关键还是天赋神通的加持，令他的生命层次一路迅猛提升。
比绝大部分觉醒了下位星相的同学提升还要快，不亚于许多本科生。
可方羽仍不敢懈怠。
“专升本。”
“进本科，会有更多机会，利用国家的资源帮助自己成长，才是正途。”方羽想的非常透彻。
他不想父亲那么累了，父亲两鬓都开始白了……
作为大哥，骨子里，他也不愿将家里钱全花光……弟弟妹妹的筑基机会也很宝贵。

"The first batch of recommendation lists is out." Fang Yu said: "I was not selected."
"Yeah." Fang Pingan was not surprised.
He did not blame, but comforted: "You haven't awakened to the void star yet. Your life level has improved well, but you are not the best in your class. In terms of skill, it is high, so it is normal that you are not selected."
Fang Ping'an knew that his son had been practicing extremely hard, so he didn't say too many empty words.
"I remember that the second assessment was held on August 15th." Fang Ping'an said: "Although there is another opportunity for a practical assessment in September... the actual combat assessment requires going to the original star."
When he mentioned the original star, Fang Pingan's eyes paused.
Fang Yu understood why.
My mother was a powerful level 28 warrior back then, but she died on the Primordial Star when she was just entering junior high school, and even her body could not be recovered... From then on, this incident has been a thorn in my father's heart.
"Actual combat assessment, the risk factor is extremely high."
"Although warriors have to go through life and death fights, it is better to wait until they are stronger." Fang Ping'an said in a low voice: "So, you have to strive to be on the second batch of recommended lists."
Fang Yu nodded slightly.
"My plan is to hire a martial arts teacher for you, give you close guidance, and buy a batch of cultivation medicine..." Fang Ping'an said: "Let's see if I can improve your life level within a month, and strive to achieve a breakthrough in martial arts skills."
Fang Yu felt warm in his heart.
My father did not change his attitude towards him just because his younger brothers and sisters had awakened... In fact, if it was a normal family, even if he had shown considerable technical talent since junior high school, he would have given up when he did not awaken to the void star in high school.
Normally speaking, raising children involves talking about the return ratio.
A road with little hope is not only a waste of money, but also a waste of children's time.
Once upon a time, Fang Yu also wavered.
But my father endured the pressure and invested millions of star coins in his own martial arts path.
later.
After the college entrance examination, Fang Yu's life level reached level 8, and he awakened his innate magical power "Swallowing". As he gradually tried it, he felt how special this magical power was, and he further strengthened his belief in martial arts and determined to find a way out.
Only in this way can he be worthy of his father's sacrifice.
but.
Even though he expected that his sleeping horoscope was very special, probably even more special than the twelve upper horoscopes, Fang Yu did not reveal too much to his father... The celestial horoscope cannot be revealed before one becomes an earth warrior.
Such as the testing methods of high school entrance examination and college entrance examination.
It is all judged by the student's efficiency in absorbing star power. The higher the astrological grade, the higher the absorption efficiency... But Fang Yu cannot absorb star power.
There is no way to confirm it.
on the other hand.
Fang Yu is also not sure how many levels of his life level he needs to fully awaken the astrology. What if he needs level 30 or even level 40? Everything is unknown.
That's something my father can't afford.
"My father has helped me a lot, and the family only has so much money."
"Brothers and sisters are still growing, and they will need more resources..." Fang Yu thought clearly: "If you want more, then work hard on your own."
This is also the reason why Fang Yu has practiced harder and harder in the past three years of junior college.
He received many scholarships from the school, and he also worked part-time, plus the money from his father... The key was the blessing of his natural talent, which made his life level rise rapidly.
He has improved faster than most of his classmates who have awakened to the lower horoscopes, and is no less than many undergraduates.
But Fang Yu still didn't dare to slack off.
"Junior to bachelor's degree."
"Entering an undergraduate degree will give you more opportunities. Using the country's resources to help you grow is the right way." Fang Yu thought very thoroughly.
He didn't want his father to be so tired, and his father's temples were starting to turn white...
As the eldest brother, deep down, he doesn't want to spend all the family's money... The opportunities for younger brothers and sisters to build their foundation are also precious.
